EMP Special Rule stays active as if the attack had Flame (1D5). The Flame will deal no Damage, but instead will continuously apply the EMP Special Rule until Flame is reduced to 0. Can’t stack.

grenade_launchers.name: M363 Remote Projectile Detonator
grenade_launchers.description: Sticky, Blast (5), Kill (2) Special Rule. Single-Shot Muzzle-loaded Grenade Launcher. The Sticky Launcher has a 120 Meter distance limit before it detonates. The M9030 Grenade that is launched can be set to detonate by enemy proximity, by timed explosive, or by setting off the detonation using the weapon. The M363 can’t be reloaded until the current armed grenade has been detonated.

grenade_launchers.name: M319 Individual Grenade Launcher
grenade_launchers.description: EMP (4), Blast (8), Kill (4) Special Rule. Capable of two detonation types. When the trigger is held after firing, the Grenade will not detonate until released. The Grenade has proximity sensors that track IFF Tags and will display friendlies and enemies within the Blast Radius. When held, the M319 gains the EMP Rule listed. When the trigger is not held, the Grenade will detonate after 6 Seconds of being fired. The Grenade detonates at the beginning of the Characters next Turn. Can’t be detonated within 10 Meters of the weapon used to fire the Grenade.

grenade_launchers.name: XM509 UDAW
grenade_launchers.description: Blast (3), Kill (1) Special Rule. Comes with: Built-in KFA-2 2x. Black Polymer finish. Aggressive gas venting and a pneumatic recoil compensation system allows this launcher to use 20x102mm autocannon rounds as ammo.

It takes 10 Full Actions to assemble and disassemble the Mortar, or 3 Full Actions with assistance. Mortar shells each weigh 14 kg. The Mortar can’t strike within Close Range.

It takes 7 Full Actions to assemble and disassemble the Mortar, or 1 Full Actions with assistance. Mortar shells each weigh 1.4 kg. The Mortar can’t strike within Close Range.

It takes 7 Full Actions to assemble and disassemble the Mortar, or 1 Full Actions with assistance. Mortar shells each weigh 1.4 kg. The Mortar can’t strike within Close Range.

melee_weapons.name: Model 52 Navy Knife

melee_weapons.name: Military Combat Kukri
melee_weapons.description: Lengthened Military Dagger with a 49cm long carbon-steel blade. Non-reflective, carbide coating, rust resistant. No Civilian or Police cR upcharge.

melee_weapons.name: MP Machete
melee_weapons.description: Military Dagger with a 30cm blade and a 12cm weighted handle. Non-reflective, carbide coating, rust resistant. No Civilian or Police cR upcharge.

melee_weapons.name: Pattern-2 Composite Sword
melee_weapons.description: Military Dagger with a 43cm blade and a 12cm weighted handle. Non-reflective, carbide coating, rust resistant. No Civilian or Police cR upcharge.

melee_weapons.name: Multi-Purpose Tomahawk
melee_weapons.description: Military Tomahawk with a 30cm head and a 38cm handle. Non-reflective, carbide coating, rust resistant. No Civilian or Police cR upcharge.

melee_weapons.name: Police Baton
melee_weapons.description: Law Enforcement baton, 91cm in length. Collapsible to 12cm with a spring-loaded mechanism for Quickdrawing. No Civilian or Police cR upcharge.

melee_weapons.name: Military Shovel
melee_weapons.description: Sharpened and small collapsible Military Shovel. Doubles as an emergency melee weapon by design.

melee_weapons.name: Sledge Hammer
melee_weapons.description: Slow and Stun (3) Special Rule. A large breeching hammer designed for forceful entry.

melee_weapons.name: Brass Knuckles
melee_weapons.description: This weapon augments the Characters Punching-based Melee Attacks by adding additional Damage.

melee_weapons.name: Humbler Stun Device
melee_weapons.description: Electrified (12) Special Rule that can be disabled. Electrified baton 51cm in length. Glows a blue or purple color, easily seen in dark lighting. No Civilian or Police cR upcharge.

melee_weapons.name: Pepper Spray
melee_weapons.description: Used to disable opponents. Pepper Spray Special Rule when sprayed in the face. No Police and Civilian upcharge. Holds 20 uses. Check Equipment Section for more information. Pepper Spray is not intercepted by Energy Shields.

melee_weapons.name: Taser Gun
melee_weapons.description: Electrified (2D10) and Sticky Special Rule. Uses Warfare Melee when Melee Reach and uses Warfare Range when being used as a projectile. No Police or Civilian upcharge.

melee_weapons.name: Anti-Ballistics Riot Shield
melee_weapons.description: Provides 20 Armor and has 300 Breakpoints. An Anti-Ballistics Riot Shield that acts as mobile cover. The Riot shield is titanium-A with a hardened plastic window to see through. The Shield covers 5 Locations for Normal sized Characters. One Attack per Half Action when making Melee Attacks.

melee_weapons.name: Spartan Shield
melee_weapons.description: A powerful shield that has 30 Armor and 400 Breakpoints. The Shield covers 5 Locations for Large sized Characters. One Attack per Half Action when making Melee Attacks. Stun (2D5+5) Special Rule. *Characters with 9 Strength Modifier and Mythic Strength combined may hold their [TH] Spartan Shield as [OH].

melee_weapons.name: Cable Cutters
melee_weapons.description: 30 Penalty to Hit against moving Characters. Common pair of large-scale cable cutters. Able to cut large chain links and other pieces of metal. More than strong enough to cut off a finger of any race. On Helpless or Stunned Characters that can’t fight back, Melee Attacks with Wire Cutters deal 2D10 +9 Damage, with 15 Pierce. If not against a Helpless or Stunned Character, Melee Attacks with this weapon gain a -30 To Hit.

melee_weapons.name: Heavy Duty Bolt Cutters
melee_weapons.description: 30 Penalty to Hit against moving Characters. Powerful bolt cutters, 1.3 meters long. Strong enough to cut through even Covenant metals and locks and can even lop off the fingers of any known Race. On Helpless or Stunned Characters that can’t fight back, Melee Attacks with Bolt Cutters deal 2D10 +14 Damage, with 18 Pierce. If not against a Helpless or Stunned Character, Melee Attacks with this weapon gain a -30 To Hit.
